name: Photometric Studio renders resolution-scaled volumetric normal maps and cel shading across dark palettes
description: Validates the 2.5D Photometric Studio on 128x128 canvases with dark crimson and navy body palettes, verifying that boundary-aware classification protects dark colors from unshaded ink-line masking, proportional bevel scaling prevents interior normal flattening, and cel-shading produces monotonic cool-indigo shadows.

planSteps.description: Navigate to https://pixibun.vercel.app/studio
Click the canvas dimensions resize control in the top navigation bar
Set canvas width to 128 and height to 128 in the resize dialog, then click Resize Canvas
Verify the viewport canvas updates to a 128x128 workspace and displays the dimension badge in the header
Select the Ellipse tool in the left toolbar and draw a circular character form on the canvas
Click the primary color well and set the active drawing color to dark crimson #8B1E3F
Select the Flood Fill tool and click inside the drawn shape to color the character body
Verify the dark crimson character body is visible on the center viewport canvas
Click the 'PixiBud AI' tab in the right inspector panel
Verify the 2.5D Photometric Studio section is visible with degree readouts and mode controls
Click the 'Manual' mode toggle button
Click the 'Polished Metal' material chip in the material selection grid
Click the 'View Normals' button to activate tangent-space normal preview
Verify the viewport switches to live normal preview displaying spherical tangent-space RGB colors across the 128x128 body
Click the 'Hide Normals' button to return to the composite artwork view
Click the 'Bake Light' button to execute directional photometric shading
Verify the dark crimson body receives directional OKLCH cel-shading with cool indigo shadow tones without being skipped as ink lines
Click the 'Bake Normal Map' button to persist tangent normals as a layer
Click the 'Layers' tab in the right inspector panel
Verify a new layer titled 'Normal Map' is present in the layers list containing the baked normal map
